secrets.name: OMEGA_SIGNING_KEY
secrets.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing key for /v1/attest (>=32 chars). A dev placeholder is provided in .env.base44-defaults; replace with a real random key for trustworthy attestations.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com → API keys) for the console's GPT engine. Without it the GPT selection answers with the clearly labelled local deterministic composer. Legacy OMEGA_LLM_API_KEY is still accepted as a fallback.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key (console.anthropic.com → API keys) for the console's Claude engine. Without it the Claude selection answers with the clearly labelled local deterministic composer.
